name: Climber Hamish

intro.text: I do the Lakeland crags with a pair of boots and a flask. The flask is more reliable.

win: I have not climbed that one before. I'll make a note of the route.
after: Latrigg, Catbells, Skiddaw. Keswick's an easy place to be a wee bit lost, and a very good place to be found.
